Hi Neighbor,

Hey Jill, 

So I went out today with just a cup of joe to start this morning in that perfect quiet that early a morning provides before life takes off again with a vengeance and what'd it look out there! This beautiful lilacs have blossom'd. The first blooms have popped and are now peek-ing over those walls, and wow what sweet and soothing fragrance that has spread throughout. It made the perfect moment, just standing in silence for what seems to me forever.

So thanks, Jill! For having neighbors with the heart and green touch. It brights our world and ours
